name: E. coli, Klebsiella, Proteus and Shigella

reference.source: Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Pink fermenters versus pale non fermenters
O157 bloody diarrhoea: fluids, no antibiotics
reference.pathophysiology: Fimbrial adhesins climb urinary tracts while Shiga toxin halts 60S ribosomes killing endothelium into microthrombi; urease alkalinises urine crystallising magnesium ammonium phosphate around Proteus nests.
additionalDifferentials: Shigella versus Salmonella by motility and H2S
EHEC versus EIEC by toxin versus invasion
Klebsiella versus pneumococcus by bacilli versus diplococci
additionalInvestigations: Urine culture with MacConkey and IMViC
Stool culture on SMAC with Shiga toxin assay
ESBL confirmatory with carbapenemase PCR in resistant isolates
